rules.statement: Mortgages are not excluded from the scope of the Money Lending Ordinance, and a professional money lender who lends money upon mortgage bonds is not entitled to enforce his claim if he has failed to keep regular books of account as required by section 8 of the Money Lending Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Mortgages are not excluded from the scope of the Money Lending Ordinance. Accordingly, a professional money lender who lends money upon mortgage bonds is not entitled to enforce his claim on a mortgage bond if he has failed to keep regular books of account as required by section 8 of the Money Lending Ordinance"
